assertions.text: Validates source and content, resolves the slug through linear-work-management and uses a NEW batch_id
Never reads or relies on the old progress file, the old approval or the old submission file
Runs exact-key dedup queries in groups of at most 50 keys against T-PROD (two groups for 58 keys)
Drops the 25 already-held records and lists each dropped key with its Issue ID in the preview
Flags the two records with no dedup_key as possible duplicates
Runs the pre-hash checks (labels exist, no closed status), writes a new file of the 35 remaining records, hashes it and asks ONE fresh approval
